1. (Currently amended) A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin __derived from chicory__; placing the cement composition in a subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 °F __and a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed __and the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin having a degree of substitution of from about 0.1 to about 0.3__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition __and the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition __at temperatures up to about 280 °F__.

6. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher.

7. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.

9. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin.

10. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof.

11. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a subterranean formation.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore __and the carboxylated inulin is derived from chicory__.

13. (Currently amended) A method of cementing in a subterranean formation comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin __derived from chicory__; placing the cement composition in the subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set therein.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 °F __and a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed __and the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin having a degree of substitution of from about 0.1 to about 0.3__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition __and the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition __at temperatures up to about 280 °F__.

18. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher.

19. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin.

20. (Original) The method of claim 19 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.

21. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin.

22. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore __and the carboxylated inulin is derived from chicory__.
